doc.title: Anne Phillips interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 24, 2025

title: Current projects and her one-woman show
summary: A piano rag, her birthday show telling her story, and Ellie Greenwich's remark to her kids.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: I’ll be darned. Well you are just — have accomplished so much in your lifetime and — you still have projects going on for the future?

Well I got a nice thing, you know I belong to the women’s New York Womens’ Music Composers thing. And every once in a while there’ll be something that a performer is looking for, and there was a piano thing that a pianist wanted. Well okay, I’ll send the thing in. And it was a rag that I wrote for a play with music called “Pan Handle” many years ago. Anyway I love rag, but I could never do anything with it. It’s a piano rag. Although one of the performers in the show ran up when I played it at the first rehearsal, he said, “What is that?” I said, “I wrote it.” He said, “Oh my God I thought it was Scott Joplin and it’s disappeared or something” which was the nicest thing he could say. Anyway I just got a thing from a woman who is a pianist who is doing a concert and she’s playing my rag in that concert at upper Americas on the nineteenth. And then I’ve been doing, you know, my birthday thing. I did a whole — I did a short show at a senior residence, which is telling my story. And I made it bigger for the birthday party. And that got sold out. And so many people have wanted to see it again. So I have a real interesting one-woman, about an hour fifteen, hour and a half show that really goes through my life of music and covers a lot of ground.
I’ll bet. And I can see many moments where people are going, “Oh, I remember that, you wrote that?”
Yeah. We did demos for Ellie.

I have to tell you a funny thing. When they did a show on “Leader of the Pack” after it was a big hit, and I took my kids when they were in middle school, to see it, because Ellie Greenwich was starring in it and so forth. And I introduced her to Ellie and Ellie looked at them and said, “I am your prenatal influence.” Because I had three kids through all of this.
Wow. Well this has been great pleasure and thank you very much for joining me today.
